entries.title: Your words are easier to pick out on cards
entries.body: The You asked line puts your words in a soft grey bubble, without quotation marks, on Mac, iPhone and iPad. Click or tap a long question’s bubble to expand it, and again to fold it, without a separate link. Its time and the revised time no longer start with a zero.

picture.alt: The You asked label sits above the captain’s words in a soft grey bubble.
